description: Find Australian manufacturers using an exact category returned by list_categories, optionally filtered by state or territory. Returns up to 50 results with ABN, name, category, suburb/state, employee range and website; excludes phone, email and street addresses. No API key required. Results are directory matches, not proof of capability. export_ready is accepted but does not filter results because verified export-readiness data is unavailable.

category.description: Exact category or ANZSIC industry name. Call list_categories first to discover valid values.

export_ready.description: Accepted but currently does not filter results; verified export-readiness data is not yet available.

limit.description: Maximum number of manufacturers to return (1-50)

name: search_manufacturers
title: Search Australian manufacturers
